evidence.reason: Line 141 runs `git init` without forcing the object format. `_git` passes an environment derived from the caller, and the supplied code does not pin `GIT_DEFAULT_HASH`; a caller setting `GIT_DEFAULT_HASH=sha256` makes `git init` create SHA-256 commit/blob IDs, which cannot match the committed SHA-1 vectors and causes `--check` to fail. Adding `--object-format=sha1` fixes the determinism defect.
